records.literal_gloss: In [the] second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on [the] first day of the month, the word of Yahweh came by [the] hand of Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying:

en.L: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came by the hand of Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying:
en.B: In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest:
en.R: In Darius's second year as king, on the first day of the sixth month of the year, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave a message through the prophet Haggai. It was for Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.

es.L: En el año segundo del rey Darío, en el mes sexto, el día primero del mes, vino la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por mano de Hageo el profeta a Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, y a Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, diciendo:
es.B: En el segundo año del reinado de Darío, en el mes sexto, el primer día del mes, la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llegó por medio del profeta Hageo a Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, y a Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote:
es.R: En el segundo año de Darío como rey, el primer día del sexto mes del año, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dio un mensaje por medio del profeta Hageo. Era para Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, y para Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote.

fr.L: La deuxième année de Darius le roi, le sixième mois, le premier jour du mois, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée par la main du prophète Aggée à Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, et à Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, disant :
fr.B: La deuxième année du règne de Darius, le sixième mois, le premier jour du mois, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée par le prophète Aggée à Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, et à Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre :
fr.R: La deuxième année où Darius était roi, le premier jour du sixième mois de l’année, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a transmis un message par le prophète Aggée. Ce message s’adressait à Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, et à Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa pili wa mfalme Dario, mwezi wa sita, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikuja kwa mkono wa Hagai nabii kwa Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda, na kwa Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, kusema:
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Dario, mwezi wa sita, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} liliwajia Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda, na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, kupitia nabii Hagai:
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa pili wa Dario kuwa mfalme, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa sita wa mwaka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitoa ujumbe kupitia nabii Hagai. Ujumbe huo ulikuwa kwa ajili ya Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda, na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu.

vi.L: Năm thứ hai đời vua Đa-ri-út, tháng thứ sáu, ngày mồng một trong tháng, lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến qua tay nhà tiên tri A-ghê với Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, và với Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, rằng:
vi.B: Ngày mồng một tháng sáu, năm thứ hai triều vua Đa-ri-út, lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến qua nhà tiên tri A-ghê với Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, và Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm:
vi.R: Ngày mồng một tháng sáu, năm thứ hai Đa-ri-út làm vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban một sứ điệp qua nhà tiên tri A-ghê. Sứ điệp ấy dành cho Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, và Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm.

ko.L: 다리오 왕 제2년 여섯째 달 초하루에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예언자 학개의 손을 통하여 유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 다리오가 다스린 지 2년째 되는 해 여섯째 달 초하루에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예언자 학개를 통하여 유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아에게 임했다.
ko.R: 다리오가 왕이 된 지 2년째 되는 해 여섯째 달 1일에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 학개를 통하여 말씀을 주셨다. 그 말씀은 유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아에게 주신 것이었다.

decisions.choice: the second year of King Darius, the sixth month, the first day: late August 520 BC
decisions.reason: Darius I ruled the Persian empire from 522 to 486 BC, so his second year was 520 BC. The months are counted from the spring, and the first day of the sixth month (Elul) fell on about 29 August 520 BC. The first day of a month, the new moon, was a day when people gathered for worship (Isaiah 66:23; Amos 8:5), so the prophet had a crowd to hear him. Haggai dates each of his messages; all four fall within four months of that year. |

decisions.choice: Joshua son of Jehozadak: the same man as "Jeshua son of Jozadak" in Ezra
decisions.reason: Haggai and Zechariah use the full form of the high priest's name, Joshua, and of his father's, Jehozadak. Ezra and Nehemiah use the later short forms, Jeshua and Jozadak (Ezra 3:2; 5:2), for the same man. Jehozadak was the priest taken into exile by Nebuchadnezzar (1 Chronicles 5:40-41 in the Hebrew numbering, 6:14-15 in many other Bibles), so Joshua was born in exile and returned with Zerubbabel. Each book keeps the form of the name its own text uses. |

decisions.choice: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah
decisions.reason: Zerubbabel was a grandson of King Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon in 597 BC (1 Chronicles 3:17-19, which names his father as Pedaiah, Shealtiel's brother; Ezra 3:2 and Haggai call him son of Shealtiel). He led a group of exiles home (Ezra 2:2) and served as governor of Judah, then a small province of the Persian empire. He is named in the family line of Jesus (Matthew 1:12; Luke 3:27). |

decisions.choice: by the hand of Haggai: through Haggai
decisions.reason: The word of the LORD came "by the hand of" the prophet: he was the one through whom it was given. Haggai is known otherwise only from Ezra 5:1 and 6:14, where he and Zechariah urge the people to rebuild the temple. |

decisions.choice: the date in the Hebrew form at every level; in the second year of Darius the king (L), of King Darius (B), in Darius's second year as king (R)
decisions.reason: Haggai's dates keep their Hebrew form, as set for the Twelve; the modern date is given in m1, not in the text. Readable says "the sixth month of the year" and follows the Jeremiah table for "the Nth year of X". |

decisions.choice: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest
decisions.reason: The two leaders are named the same way at every level and in every verse of Haggai where the Hebrew names them so (1:12, 14; 2:2, 4). "The high priest" is the usual English for "the great priest". Balanced and Readable drop the second "to"; Readable splits the heading into two sentences. Haggai is prose: dated reports of the prophet's messages and of what the people did. |

decisions.choice: "en el año segundo del rey Darío, en el mes sexto, el día primero del mes" (L); "en el segundo año del reinado de Darío ..." (B); "en el segundo año de Darío como rey, el primer día del sexto mes del año" (R); "por mano de Hageo el profeta" (L), "por medio del profeta Hageo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The dated headings of Haggai keep their Hebrew form at every level, as the term sheet sets for Haggai and Zechariah; no level turns them into a modern date (the culture note gives it). "By the hand of" is kept word for word at Literal only. Recorded once for Haggai.

decisions.choice: "Hageo"; "Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá"; "Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote"
decisions.reason: The forms published in Ezra 5:1-2, where the same men are named. Haggai's Hebrew has the long forms Yehoshua and Yehotsadaq where Ezra has Yeshua and Yotsadaq (m2), so the high priest is "Josué" here, as the English "Joshua", and Ezra keeps "Jesúa"; the father keeps the one published Spanish form "Josadac". The two leaders are named the same way through the book.

decisions.choice: "La deuxième année de Darius le roi, le sixième mois, le premier jour du mois" (L) / "du règne de Darius" (B) / "où Darius était roi" (R); "par la main du prophète Aggée" (L), "par le prophète Aggée" (B, R); "Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda", "Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre"
decisions.reason: The date formula and the names of the term sheet for Haggai. Haggai's Hebrew has the long forms of the high priest's name and his father's, so French says "Josué fils de Yehotsadaq" where the published Ezra 3:2 and 5:2 say "Yeshoua fils de Yotsadaq" for the same man (m2). No level converts the date.

decisions.choice: Narrative frames in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("fut adressée", "écoutèrent") and in the passé composé at Readable ("a transmis", "ont écouté"); the LORD's messages are speech (present, future, passé composé)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for the dated frames of Haggai: written French narrative uses the passé simple, and the Readable level the tense of spoken French. Recorded once for chapter 1.

decisions.choice: "katika mwaka wa pili wa mfalme Dario, mwezi wa sita, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi" (L); "... wa utawala wa Dario" (B); "katika mwaka wa pili wa Dario kuwa mfalme" (R); "kwa mkono wa Hagai nabii" (L), "kupitia nabii Hagai" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form for the dated headings of Haggai and Zechariah, with no modern date in the text. Literal keeps the Hebrew "by the hand of"; Balanced and Readable say "through". Narrative verbs use -li- then -ka- in the frames of the book.

decisions.choice: "Hagai"; "Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda"; "Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu"
decisions.reason: "Hagai" and "Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli" are the published forms of Ezra 5:1-2. Haggai's Hebrew gives the high priest and his father their long names (m2), so Swahili follows 1 Chronicles 5:40 "Yehosadaki" and says "Yoshua", where Ezra has "Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki" for the same man.

decisions.choice: "năm thứ hai đời vua Đa-ri-út, tháng thứ sáu, ngày mồng một trong tháng" (L); "ngày mồng một tháng sáu, năm thứ hai triều vua Đa-ri-út" (B); "ngày mồng một tháng sáu, năm thứ hai Đa-ri-út làm vua" (R); "qua tay nhà tiên tri A-ghê" (L), "qua nhà tiên tri A-ghê" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's dated heading: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, Balanced and Readable the Vietnamese order of day, month and year, as Ezra 6:15; days one to ten take "mồng". No level converts to a modern date.

decisions.choice: "A-ghê"; "Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa"; "Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm"
decisions.reason: The published forms of Ezra 5:1-2 for Haggai and Zerubbabel. Haggai's Hebrew has the long names of the high priest and his father (m2): "Giô-suê", the same Hebrew name as Moses' successor, and "Giê-hô-xa-đác" as 1 Chronicles 5:40, where Ezra has "Giê-sua con trai Giô-xa-đác" for the same man. The 1926 form of the name is "Giê-hô-sua".

decisions.choice: "다리오 왕 제2년 여섯째 달 초하루에" (L); "다리오가 다스린 지 2년째 되는 해 여섯째 달 초하루에" (B); "다리오가 왕이 된 지 2년째 되는 해 여섯째 달 1일에" (R); "예언자 학개의 손을 통하여" (L), "예언자 학개를 통하여" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Kings formula for dated headings, as the term sheet sets it for Haggai and Zechariah; months and days are in words at Literal and Balanced. No level converts to a modern date. The heading ends in a period, not the English colon.

decisions.choice: "학개"; "유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨"; "여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아"
decisions.reason: "학개" and "스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨" are published in Ezra 5:1-2. Haggai's Hebrew has the long names of the high priest and his father (m2), written as 1 Chronicles 5:40 (여호사닥) and as Moses' successor (여호수아); Ezra's short form "요사닥의 아들 예수아" names the same man.

source.text: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֶת־בֹּ֛א עֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה לְהִבָּנֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, saying: This people have said, [It is] not [the] time to come, [the] time [for the] house of Yahweh to be rebuilt.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: This people says, "The time has not come, the time for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to be rebuilt."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: These people are saying, "The time has not come, the time to rebuild {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house."
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: The people say, "It is not yet time to build the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} again."

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Este pueblo dice: «No ha llegado el tiempo, el tiempo de que la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sea reedificada».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Esta gente anda diciendo: «Todavía no ha llegado el tiempo, el tiempo de reconstruir la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: La gente dice: «Todavía no es tiempo de volver a construir el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Ce peuple dit : « Le temps n’est pas venu, le temps que la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} soit rebâtie. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Ces gens disent : « Le temps n’est pas venu, le temps de rebâtir la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Le peuple dit : « Ce n’est pas encore le moment de reconstruire le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Watu hawa wamesema, "Wakati haujafika, wakati wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kujengwa upya."
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Watu hawa wanasema, "Wakati haujafika, wakati wa kuijenga upya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Watu wanasema, "Bado si wakati wa kulijenga tena hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Dân này nói: "Thời điểm chưa đến, thời điểm để nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được xây lại."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Dân này cứ nói: "Chưa đến lúc, chưa đến lúc xây lại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Dân chúng nói: "Chưa phải lúc xây lại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이 백성이 "때가 이르지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집이 다시 지어질 때가 [이르지 않았다]" 하고 말한다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 이 백성은 "아직 때가 되지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 다시 지을 때가 되지 않았다" 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 백성은 "아직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 다시 지을 때가 아니다" 하고 말한다.

decisions.choice: this people: said with distance, not "my people"
decisions.reason: The LORD does not call them "my people" here. The same phrase shows his displeasure in Isaiah 6:9-10 and Jeremiah 14:10-11. |

decisions.choice: the house of the LORD: the temple in Jerusalem, still in ruins
decisions.reason: Solomon's temple was destroyed by the Babylonians in 587 BC (2 Kings 25:9). Exiles returned after Cyrus's decree of 538 BC and laid a foundation, but opposition from their neighbors stopped the work (Ezra 3:8-4:5, 24). Sixteen years or more later it still lay in ruins, and the people said the right time had not come. |

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD of hosts (L), The LORD of Armies says this (B), This is what the LORD of Armies says (R); house (L, B), temple (R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the Isaiah table. Literal and Balanced keep "house", which Haggai sets against the people's own houses (verses 4 and 9); Readable says "temple" so that the reader knows which building is meant, and the contrast is carried by "your own houses". |

decisions.choice: "Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos:" (L); "{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto:" (B); "Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos:" (R); after an oracle "declara / afirma / dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}" for "declares", and "dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}" at every level for "says"
decisions.reason: The prophets' formulas and "the LORD of hosts" as Isaiah and Jeremiah publish them: lowercase "ejércitos" at Literal, "Ejércitos" as a title at Balanced and Readable. The divine name is always the setting span, with "Yahvé" as the alternative. Recorded once for Haggai.

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées :" (L); "{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci :" (B); "Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées :" (R); "déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}" (L, B) / "dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}" (R) for "declares"; "dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}" for "says"
decisions.reason: The formulas of the term sheet, and "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level, as Isaiah and Jeremiah publish it; the divine name is the setting span with "Yahvé" as the alternative. Recorded once for Haggai.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi:" (L); "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo:" (B); "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema:" (R); "asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}" (L, B) / "anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}" (R) after an oracle
decisions.reason: The prophets' formulas and "BWANA wa majeshi" as published in Isaiah and Jeremiah, never "Sabaoth". BWANA is always the setting span with "Yahwe" as the alternative. Recorded once for Haggai.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này:" (L); "... phán như vầy:" (B); "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán:" (R); "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy" (L, B) / "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán" (R) for "declares"; "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán" at every level for "says" at the end of a saying
decisions.reason: The formulas of the Isaiah note and the term sheet for Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi; the span covers CHÚA only, and "Vạn Quân" stays outside it. Recorded once for Haggai.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다." (L); "…이렇게 말씀하신다." (B); "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다." decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms for "the LORD of hosts" and the oracle formulas, ending in a period; every YHWH is the setting span with the particle outside it, and 여호와 is not used. Recorded once for Haggai.

vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban sứ điệp này qua nhà tiên tri A-ghê:

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예언자 학개의 손을 통하여 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예언자 학개를 통하여 임했다.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 학개를 통하여 이 말씀을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD came: the LORD's answer to what the people said
decisions.reason: The heading introduces the LORD's reply to the people's excuse in verse 2. "By the hand of" means through, as in verse 1. |

decisions.choice: came by the hand of (L), came through (B), gave this message through (R)
decisions.reason: The wording follows verse 1 at each level. |

decisions.choice: Narrative in the plain written style (했다) with -시- and 께서 for God at every level; the LORD's messages in 해라체, without -시- in his own mouth
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide and the term sheet set it for the narrative frames of the prophets. Recorded once for Haggai.

source.text: הַעֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֣ם סְפוּנִ֑ים וְהַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה חָרֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house [lies] desolate?

en.L: Is it a time for you, you yourselves, to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house [is] desolate?
en.B: Is it a time for you yourselves to live in paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?
en.R: Is it the right time for you to live in fine houses with wood-paneled walls, while this temple is still in ruins?

es.L: ¿Es tiempo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos, de habitar en {{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}} artesonadas, mientras esta casa [está] desolada?
es.B: ¿Es tiempo de que {{plural_you:ustedes mismos vivan|vosotros mismos viváis}} en casas artesonadas, mientras esta casa está en ruinas?
es.R: ¿Es este el momento de que {{plural_you:ustedes vivan|vosotros viváis}} en casas finas con paredes recubiertas de madera, mientras este templo sigue en ruinas?

fr.L: Est-ce le temps pour vous, vous-mêmes, d’habiter dans vos maisons lambrissées, tandis que cette maison [est] dévastée ?
fr.B: Est-ce le moment pour vous-mêmes d’habiter des maisons lambrissées, alors que cette maison est en ruine ?
fr.R: Est-ce le bon moment pour vous d’habiter de belles maisons aux murs couverts de boiseries, alors que ce temple est toujours en ruine ?

sw.L: Je, ni wakati kwenu, ninyi wenyewe, kukaa katika nyumba zenu zilizopigwa mbao, na nyumba hii [ni] ukiwa?
sw.B: Je, ni wakati wa ninyi wenyewe kukaa katika nyumba zilizopambwa kwa mbao, wakati nyumba hii imebaki magofu?
sw.R: Je, huu ni wakati unaofaa kwenu kuishi katika nyumba nzuri zenye kuta zilizofunikwa kwa mbao, wakati hekalu hili bado ni magofu?

vi.L: Có phải là lúc cho các ngươi, chính các ngươi, ở trong nhà ốp gỗ của các ngươi, trong khi nhà này [bị] hoang tàn?
vi.B: Có phải đây là lúc chính các ngươi được ở trong những ngôi nhà ốp gỗ, trong khi nhà này còn đổ nát?
vi.R: Có phải đây là lúc thích hợp để các ngươi sống trong những ngôi nhà sang trọng có tường ốp gỗ, trong khi đền thờ này vẫn còn đổ nát không?

ko.L: 이 집이 황폐[한데], 너희, 바로 너희가 판자를 댄 너희 집에 살 때이냐?
ko.B: 이 집이 폐허로 남아 있는데, 너희만 판자로 꾸민 집에 살 때이냐?
ko.R: 이 성전은 아직도 무너진 채로 있는데, 너희는 벽을 나무로 꾸민 좋은 집에서 살고 있다. 지금이 그럴 때이냐?

decisions.choice: is it a time for you: a reply to "the time has not come"
decisions.reason: The people said the time had not come for the LORD's house (verse 2). The LORD asks whether it is the time for their own fine houses. "You yourselves" is emphatic. |

decisions.choice: paneled houses: houses lined or roofed with wood
decisions.reason: The word is used of the cedar paneling of Solomon's temple and palace (1 Kings 6:9; 7:3, 7) and of a king's luxurious house (Jeremiah 22:14). It may mean walls lined with wood or simply roofed. Either way the people have homes finished and comfortable, while the LORD's house lies open.

decisions.choice: desolate: in ruins, dry and waste
decisions.reason: The word means "dry, laid waste". It sounds like the word for "drought" in verse 11, which is the LORD's answer: their land will be as dry as his house is waste. |

decisions.choice: fine houses with wood-paneled walls (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what paneled houses were (m2). |

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} on every plural "you" in Haggai, verbs and possessives included ("{{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}}")
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to the whole people, so every "you" in his messages is plural and takes the plural_you setting, Latin American forms by default; where "su" with "ustedes" could be misread, the span takes in the noun. Zerubbabel and Joshua addressed one by one are "tú". Recorded once for Haggai.

decisions.choice: The LORD calls the people "các ngươi" at every level
decisions.reason: The messages of Haggai 1 are a rebuke, and the address note gives "các ngươi" at every level for the people in rebuke; Zerubbabel addressed alone (2:4, 23) is "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם עַל־דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, thus says Yahweh of hosts: Set your heart on your ways.

en.L: And now, thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Set your heart on your ways.
en.B: So now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: Think carefully about how you are living.
en.R: Now this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: Think carefully about the way you have been living and what it has brought you.

es.L: Y ahora, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: {{plural_you:Pongan su corazón|Poned vuestro corazón}} en {{plural_you:sus caminos|vuestros caminos}}.
es.B: Así que ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: {{plural_you:Piensen bien en cómo están viviendo|Pensad bien en cómo estáis viviendo}}.
es.R: Ahora, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: {{plural_you:Piensen bien en la manera en que han estado viviendo y en lo que eso les ha traído|Pensad bien en la manera en que habéis estado viviendo y en lo que eso os ha traído}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Mettez votre cœur sur vos chemins.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Réfléchissez bien à votre manière de vivre.
fr.R: Maintenant, voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Réfléchissez bien à la façon dont vous avez vécu et à ce que cela vous a apporté.

sw.L: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Wekeni moyo wenu juu ya njia zenu.
sw.B: Basi sasa, hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Fikirini kwa makini jinsi mnavyoishi.
sw.R: Sasa hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Fikirini kwa makini jinsi mlivyokuwa mkiishi na yale yaliyowapata kwa sababu hiyo.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Hãy đặt lòng các ngươi trên đường lối của các ngươi.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về cách các ngươi đang sống.
vi.R: Bây giờ, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về cách các ngươi đã sống và những gì cách sống ấy đem lại cho các ngươi.

ko.L: 그러므로 이제 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희 마음을 너희 길에 두어라.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 어떻게 살고 있는지 깊이 생각해 보아라.
ko.R: 이제 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희가 지금까지 어떻게 살아왔는지, 그 결과가 어떠했는지 깊이 생각해 보아라.

decisions.choice: set your heart on your ways: think carefully about what you are doing and what has come of it
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought, so to "set the heart on" something is to give it careful thought. "Your ways" are their conduct, and the results it brings, which verse 6 lists. Haggai repeats the call in verse 7 and in 2:15 and 2:18. |

decisions.choice: Think carefully about how you are living (B); the way you have been living and what it has brought you (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1). Readable adds "what it has brought you" because verse 6 goes on to list the results. The same wording is used in verse 7. |

source.text: זְרַעְתֶּ֨ם הַרְבֵּ֜ה וְהָבֵ֣א מְעָ֗ט אָכ֤וֹל וְאֵין־לְשָׂבְעָה֙ שָׁת֣וֹ וְאֵין־לְשָׁכְרָ֔ה לָב֖וֹשׁ וְאֵין־לְחֹ֣ם ל֑וֹ וְהַ֨מִּשְׂתַּכֵּ֔ר מִשְׂתַּכֵּ֖ר אֶל־צְר֥וֹר נָקֽוּב׃פ

records.literal_gloss: You have sown much and brought in little; eating, but there is no satisfying; drinking, but there is no drunkenness; clothing [yourselves], but there is no warmth to him; and the one earning wages earns wages into a bag pierced.

en.L: You have sown much and brought in little; eating, but not to be satisfied; drinking, but not to be filled; putting on clothes, but no one is warm; and the one who earns wages earns wages for a bag with holes.
en.B: You have sown much and harvested little. You eat, yet are never satisfied; you drink, yet never have your fill; you dress, yet no one is warm. And whoever earns wages earns them only to put them in a purse with holes.
en.R: You have planted a lot of seed, but you have harvested very little. You eat, but you are still hungry. You drink, but you are still thirsty. You put on clothes, but you are not warm. The money you earn disappears, as if you put it in a bag with holes in it.

es.L: {{plural_you:Han sembrado|Habéis sembrado}} mucho y {{plural_you:han recogido|habéis recogido}} poco; comer, pero no hasta saciarse; beber, pero no hasta quedar llenos; vestirse, pero nadie entra en calor; y el que gana jornal, gana jornal para una bolsa rota.
es.B: {{plural_you:Han sembrado|Habéis sembrado}} mucho y {{plural_you:han cosechado|habéis cosechado}} poco. {{plural_you:Comen|Coméis}}, pero nunca {{plural_you:quedan satisfechos|quedáis satisfechos}}; {{plural_you:beben|bebéis}}, pero nunca {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} bastante; {{plural_you:se visten|os vestís}}, pero nadie entra en calor. Y el que gana un salario lo gana solo para echarlo en una bolsa rota.
es.R: {{plural_you:Han plantado|Habéis plantado}} mucha semilla, pero {{plural_you:han cosechado|habéis cosechado}} muy poco. {{plural_you:Comen|Coméis}}, pero {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} con hambre. {{plural_you:Beben|Bebéis}}, pero {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} con sed. {{plural_you:Se ponen|Os ponéis}} ropa, pero no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} calor. El dinero que {{plural_you:ganan|ganáis}} desaparece, como si lo {{plural_you:echaran|echarais}} en una bolsa agujereada.

fr.L: Vous avez semé beaucoup et rentré peu ; manger, mais sans être rassasié ; boire, mais sans avoir assez ; se vêtir, mais personne n’a chaud ; et celui qui gagne un salaire gagne son salaire pour un sac percé.
fr.B: Vous avez beaucoup semé et peu récolté. Vous mangez, mais vous n’êtes jamais rassasiés ; vous buvez, mais vous n’avez jamais assez ; vous vous habillez, mais personne n’a chaud. Et celui qui gagne un salaire le gagne pour le mettre dans une bourse trouée.
fr.R: Vous avez semé beaucoup de grain, mais vous avez très peu récolté. Vous mangez, mais vous avez encore faim. Vous buvez, mais vous avez encore soif. Vous vous habillez, mais vous n’avez pas chaud. L’argent que vous gagnez disparaît, comme si vous le mettiez dans un sac troué.

sw.L: Mmepanda mengi na kuleta kidogo; kula, lakini si kushiba; kunywa, lakini si kutosheka; kuvaa nguo, lakini hakuna apataye joto; na yeye apataye mshahara, apata mshahara kwa ajili ya mfuko uliotobolewa.
sw.B: Mmepanda mengi na kuvuna kidogo. Mnakula, lakini hamshibi; mnakunywa, lakini hamtosheki; mnavaa nguo, lakini hakuna anayepata joto. Na anayepata mshahara anaupata ili kuutia katika mfuko wenye matundu.
sw.R: Mmepanda mbegu nyingi, lakini mmevuna kidogo sana. Mnakula, lakini bado mna njaa. Mnakunywa, lakini bado mna kiu. Mnavaa nguo, lakini hamsikii joto. Pesa mnazopata zinatoweka, kana kwamba mmezitia katika mfuko wenye matundu.

vi.L: Các ngươi đã gieo nhiều mà thu vào ít; ăn, mà không được no; uống, mà không được đủ; mặc áo, mà chẳng ai được ấm; và kẻ làm thuê lãnh tiền công để bỏ vào túi thủng.
vi.B: Các ngươi gieo nhiều mà gặt ít. Các ngươi ăn mà chẳng bao giờ no; uống mà chẳng bao giờ đủ; mặc áo mà chẳng ai thấy ấm. Còn ai làm thuê lãnh công thì như bỏ tiền vào túi thủng.
vi.R: Các ngươi đã gieo nhiều hạt giống nhưng gặt được rất ít. Các ngươi ăn nhưng vẫn đói. Các ngươi uống nhưng vẫn khát. Các ngươi mặc áo nhưng không thấy ấm. Tiền các ngươi kiếm được biến mất, như thể bỏ vào một cái túi thủng.

ko.L: 너희가 많이 뿌렸으나 적게 거두어들였고, 먹어도 배부르지 않고, 마셔도 흡족하지 않고, 옷을 입어도 따뜻한 사람이 없으며, 품삯을 받는 자는 구멍 뚫린 자루에 [넣으려고] 품삯을 받는다.
ko.B: 너희는 많이 심었으나 적게 거두었다. 먹어도 배부르지 않고, 마셔도 넉넉하지 않으며, 옷을 입어도 따뜻하지 않다. 품삯을 받아도 구멍 난 주머니에 넣는 것과 같다.
ko.R: 너희는 씨를 많이 뿌렸지만 거둔 것은 아주 적다. 먹어도 여전히 배고프고, 마셔도 여전히 목마르다. 옷을 입어도 따뜻하지 않다. 너희가 번 돈은 구멍 난 자루에 넣은 것처럼 금방 없어진다.

decisions.choice: sown much, brought in little: the curses of the covenant
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:38-40 and Leviticus 26:20, 26 warn that a disobedient people will sow much and gather little, and eat without being satisfied. Hosea 4:10 and Micah 6:14-15 use the same pattern. Haggai's hearers are living under these curses. |

decisions.choice: drinking, but not to be filled: there is not enough to drink one's fill
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "be drunk", but here, beside "eat and not be satisfied", it means drinking as much as one wants (compare Song of Songs 5:1). The point is shortage, not drunkenness. |

decisions.choice: wages into a bag with holes: earnings that vanish as soon as they are earned
decisions.reason: Silver was kept in a cloth bag or purse. With poor harvests, prices were high and wages ran out at once, as if the purse had holes. |

decisions.choice: not to be filled (L), never have your fill (B), still thirsty (R)
decisions.reason: Every level gives the sense of the verb here (m2), so that no level speaks of drunkenness. Literal keeps the short Hebrew phrases without verbs ("eating, but not to be satisfied"). |

decisions.choice: "comer, pero no hasta saciarse; beber, pero no hasta quedar llenos"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's short infinitive phrases, as the English Literal does, and "quedar llenos" gives the sense of the verb here, not drunkenness (m2).

decisions.choice: "manger, mais sans être rassasié ; boire, mais sans avoir assez ; se vêtir"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's short phrases without a finite verb; "sans avoir assez" says what the verb means here (m2), not drunkenness.

source.text: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם עַל־דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: Set your heart on your ways.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Set your heart on your ways.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: Think carefully about how you are living.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: Think carefully about the way you have been living and what it has brought you.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: {{plural_you:Pongan su corazón|Poned vuestro corazón}} en {{plural_you:sus caminos|vuestros caminos}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: {{plural_you:Piensen bien en cómo están viviendo|Pensad bien en cómo estáis viviendo}}.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: {{plural_you:Piensen bien en la manera en que han estado viviendo y en lo que eso les ha traído|Pensad bien en la manera en que habéis estado viviendo y en lo que eso os ha traído}}.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Mettez votre cœur sur vos chemins.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Réfléchissez bien à votre manière de vivre.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Réfléchissez bien à la façon dont vous avez vécu et à ce que cela vous a apporté.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Wekeni moyo wenu juu ya njia zenu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Fikirini kwa makini jinsi mnavyoishi.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Fikirini kwa makini jinsi mlivyokuwa mkiishi na yale yaliyowapata kwa sababu hiyo.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Hãy đặt lòng các ngươi trên đường lối của các ngươi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về cách các ngươi đang sống.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về cách các ngươi đã sống và những gì cách sống ấy đem lại cho các ngươi.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희 마음을 너희 길에 두어라.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 어떻게 살고 있는지 깊이 생각해 보아라.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희가 지금까지 어떻게 살아왔는지, 그 결과가 어떠했는지 깊이 생각해 보아라.

decisions.choice: set your heart on your ways: said again, now leading to the command of verse 8
decisions.reason: Verse 5 used these words to point back to the people's hardships. Here they lead into what the people must now do. |

decisions.choice: the wording of verse 5 at each level
decisions.reason: The repeated call keeps the wording of verse 5 at each level. |

source.text: עֲל֥וּ הָהָ֛ר וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם עֵ֖ץ וּבְנ֣וּ הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶרְצֶה־בּ֥וֹ וְאֶכָּבְדָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Go up [to] the hill country and bring wood and build the house, that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says Yahweh.

en.L: Go up [to] the hills and bring wood and build the house; and I will be pleased with it and will be glorified, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Go up into the hills, bring down timber, and build the house. Then I will be pleased with it and will be honored, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Go up into the hills and bring down wood. Build the temple. Then I will be pleased with it, and I will be honored there, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Suban|Subid}} al monte y {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} madera y {{plural_you:edifiquen|edificad}} la casa; y me complaceré en ella y seré glorificado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Suban|Subid}} a los montes, {{plural_you:bajen|bajad}} madera y {{plural_you:construyan|construid}} la casa. Entonces me complaceré en ella y seré honrado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Suban|Subid}} a los montes y {{plural_you:bajen|bajad}} madera. {{plural_you:Construyan|Construid}} el templo. Entonces me agradará, y allí seré honrado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Montez à la montagne, apportez du bois et bâtissez la maison ; et j’y prendrai plaisir et je serai glorifié, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Montez dans les collines, rapportez du bois et bâtissez la maison. Alors je l’agréerai et je serai honoré, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Montez dans les collines et rapportez du bois. Construisez le temple. Alors il me plaira, et j’y serai honoré, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Pandeni mlimani, mlete miti, mjenge nyumba; nami nitapendezwa nayo, nami nitatukuzwa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Pandeni milimani, mshushe miti, mjenge nyumba. Ndipo nitapendezwa nayo na kuheshimiwa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Pandeni milimani mlete miti. Jengeni hekalu. Ndipo nitapendezwa nalo, nami nitaheshimiwa humo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Hãy lên núi, đem gỗ về và xây nhà; thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ vui lòng về nhà ấy và sẽ được tôn vinh, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Hãy lên đồi, đem gỗ xuống và xây nhà. Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hài lòng về nhà ấy và sẽ được tôn kính, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Hãy lên đồi và đem gỗ xuống. Hãy xây đền thờ. Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ vui lòng về đền thờ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được tôn kính tại đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 산에 올라가 나무를 가져와 그 집을 지어라. 그러면 내가 그것을 기뻐하고 영광을 받을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 산으로 올라가 나무를 가지고 내려와서 그 집을 지어라. 그러면 내가 그 집을 기뻐하고 높임을 받을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 산에 올라가서 나무를 가지고 내려와 성전을 지어라. 그러면 내가 그것을 기뻐하고, 거기에서 높임을 받을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: go up to the hills and bring wood: timber for the rebuilding
decisions.reason: Timber for roofs and beams could be cut in the wooded hills around Judah (Nehemiah 8:15). Cedar for the first rebuilding had been brought from Lebanon (Ezra 3:7). Much of the stone was probably still on the site. |

decisions.choice: take pleasure in it: accept it with favor
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God accepting an offering or a person with favor (Leviticus 1:4; Malachi 1:10). The rebuilt house will be acceptable to him. |

decisions.choice: be glorified: be honored, have my glory shown there
decisions.reason: The verb is from the same root as "glory" (2:3, 7, 9). The LORD will be honored when his house is rebuilt and his glory dwells in it. The Hebrew is written without its last letter and read with it. Jewish tradition took the missing letter, which stands for the number five, as a sign of five things the second temple would lack that the first had, among them the ark and the fire from heaven. |

decisions.choice: be glorified (L), be honored (B, R); bring down (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "honored", which suits the verb, and "bring down" because the wood comes from the hills to the city. |

source.text: פָּנֹ֤ה אֶל־הַרְבֵּה֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה לִמְעָ֔ט וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם הַבַּ֖יִת וְנָפַ֣חְתִּי ב֑וֹ יַ֣עַן מֶ֗ה נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֗עַן בֵּיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא חָרֵ֔ב וְאַתֶּ֥ם רָצִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: You looked for much, and look, [it came] to little; and you brought [it] home, and I blew on it. Because of what? declaration of Yahweh of hosts. Because of my house, which [lies] desolate, while you [are] running, each to his own house.

en.L: You looked for much, and see, [it came] to little; and you brought [it] home, and I blew on it. Why? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. Because of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house, which lies desolate, while you run, each to {{gender:their|his}} own house.
en.B: You expected much, but it came to little; whatever you brought home, I blew it away. Why? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. Because {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house lies in ruins while each of you hurries off to {{gender:your|his}} own house.
en.R: You hoped for big harvests, but you got very little. And what you did bring home, I blew away like dust. Why? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. Because {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple is still in ruins, while all of you are busy with your own houses.

es.L: {{plural_you:Buscaron|Buscasteis}} mucho, y he aquí, [resultó] poco; y lo {{plural_you:trajeron|trajisteis}} a casa, y yo soplé sobre ello. ¿Por qué?, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. Por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa, que está desolada, mientras {{plural_you:ustedes corren|vosotros corréis}} cada uno a su propia casa.
es.B: {{plural_you:Esperaban|Esperabais}} mucho, pero resultó poco; y lo que {{plural_you:llevaron|llevasteis}} a casa, yo lo dispersé de un soplo. ¿Por qué?, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa está en ruinas, mientras cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se apresura a ocuparse de su propia casa.
es.R: {{plural_you:Esperaban|Esperabais}} grandes cosechas, pero {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}} muy poco. Y lo que {{plural_you:llevaron|llevasteis}} a casa, yo lo soplé como polvo. ¿Por qué?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo sigue en ruinas, mientras todos {{plural_you:ustedes están ocupados|vosotros estáis ocupados}} con {{plural_you:sus propias casas|vuestras propias casas}}.

fr.L: Vous comptiez sur beaucoup, et voici, [il y eut] peu ; et vous l’avez rapporté à la maison, et j’ai soufflé dessus. Pourquoi ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. À cause de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison, qui est dévastée, tandis que vous courez, chacun à sa propre maison.
fr.B: Vous attendiez beaucoup, mais cela s’est réduit à peu ; ce que vous rapportiez chez vous, je l’ai dispersé d’un souffle. Pourquoi ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Parce que {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison est en ruine, tandis que chacun de vous s’empresse pour sa propre maison.
fr.R: Vous espériez de grosses récoltes, mais vous avez eu très peu. Et ce que vous rapportiez chez vous, je l’ai fait s’envoler comme de la poussière. Pourquoi ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Parce que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple est toujours en ruine, alors que vous êtes tous occupés de vos propres maisons.

sw.L: Mlitazamia mengi, na tazama, [yakawa] kidogo; nanyi mlipoyaleta nyumbani, nikayapulizia mbali. Kwa sababu gani? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kwa sababu ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ambayo ni ukiwa, nanyi mnakimbia, kila mtu kwa nyumba yake mwenyewe.
sw.B: Mlitarajia mengi, lakini yakawa kidogo; mlichokileta nyumbani, nilikipeperusha. Kwa nini? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kwa sababu nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} imebaki magofu, huku kila mmoja wenu akihangaikia nyumba yake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Mlitarajia mavuno mengi, lakini mlipata kidogo sana. Na kile mlicholeta nyumbani, nilikipeperusha kama vumbi. Kwa nini? anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kwa sababu hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} bado ni magofu, huku ninyi nyote mkishughulika na nyumba zenu wenyewe.

vi.L: Các ngươi trông mong nhiều, mà kìa, [chỉ được] ít; và các ngươi đem về nhà, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thổi bay đi. Vì sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. Vì nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn hoang tàn, trong khi các ngươi ai nấy chạy lo nhà riêng của mình.
vi.B: Các ngươi mong được nhiều, nhưng thu được ít; những gì các ngươi đem về nhà, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thổi bay đi. Tại sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. Vì nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} còn đổ nát, trong khi mỗi người trong các ngươi vội vàng lo cho nhà riêng của mình.
vi.R: Các ngươi mong được mùa lớn, nhưng chỉ thu được rất ít. Còn những gì các ngươi đem về nhà, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thổi bay như bụi. Tại sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Vì đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn còn đổ nát, trong khi tất cả các ngươi chỉ lo bận rộn với nhà riêng của mình.

ko.L: 너희가 많은 것을 바랐으나, 보라, 적은 것이 [되었고], 너희가 그것을 집으로 가져왔으나 내가 그것을 불어 버렸다. 무엇 때문이냐? 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내 집은 황폐한데, 너희는 저마다 자기 집으로 달려가기 때문이다.
ko.B: 너희가 많이 거두기를 바랐으나 적게 거두었고, 너희가 집으로 가져온 것도 내가 불어 날려 버렸다. 왜 그러하냐? 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내 집은 무너진 채로 있는데, 너희가 저마다 자기 집 일에만 바쁘기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너희는 풍성한 수확을 바랐으나 아주 조금밖에 거두지 못했다. 그나마 집으로 가져온 것도 내가 먼지처럼 날려 버렸다. 왜 그랬겠느냐? 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내 성전은 아직도 무너져 있는데, 너희는 모두 자기 집 일에만 바쁘기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: I blew on it: I blew it away like chaff
alternatives: I blew on it to curse it
decisions.reason: What little they brought home did not last; the LORD blew it away, as wind blows chaff (Isaiah 40:7, 24). Some take the blowing as a curse breathed on it. |

decisions.choice: running, each to his own house: busy with their own homes
decisions.reason: They are eager and quick about their own houses, while the LORD's house waits. The contrast between "my house" and "his own house" is the point of the verse. |

decisions.choice: Because of what?: the LORD asks the question and answers it
decisions.reason: The question and answer make the cause plain: the poor harvests are the result of neglecting the temple. |

decisions.choice: each to their own house (L), each of you to your own house (B, gender default)
decisions.reason: "Each" means every person in the community, so Literal and Balanced use the gender setting; Readable says "all of you ... your own houses", which already includes everyone. |

decisions.choice: "cada uno a su propia casa" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "cada uno ... su" already speaks of every person in the community, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart here or in 2:12.

decisions.choice: "chacun à sa propre maison" with no gender span
decisions.reason: French "chacun ... sa" already includes every person, so the English gender setting needs no French span, here or in 2:12 ("son vêtement").

decisions.choice: "kila mtu kwa nyumba yake" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "mtu" and "-ake" cover men and women alike, so the English gender setting needs no Swahili span, here or in 2:12.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy ... nhà riêng của mình" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Ai", "người" and "mình" already include everyone, so the English gender setting has no Vietnamese counterpart, here or in 2:12.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֣ן עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם כָּלְא֥וּ שָמַ֖יִםמִטָּ֑ל וְהָאָ֖רֶץ כָּלְאָ֥ה יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, because of you, [the] heavens have withheld from dew, and the earth has withheld its produce.

en.L: Therefore, on your account, the heavens have held back the dew, and the earth has held back its produce.
en.B: That is why, because of you, the sky has kept back its dew and the earth has kept back its crops.
en.R: That is why the sky does not send dew and the ground does not grow crops. It is because of you.

es.L: Por tanto, por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los cielos han retenido el rocío, y la tierra ha retenido su fruto.
es.B: Por eso, por culpa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el cielo ha retenido su rocío y la tierra ha retenido sus cosechas.
es.R: Por eso el cielo no envía rocío y la tierra no produce cosechas. Es por culpa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, à cause de vous, les cieux ont retenu la rosée, et la terre a retenu son produit.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi, à cause de vous, le ciel a retenu sa rosée et la terre a retenu ses récoltes.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que le ciel n’envoie plus de rosée et que la terre ne donne plus de récoltes. C’est à cause de vous.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, kwa ajili yenu, mbingu zimezuia umande, na nchi imezuia mazao yake.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu, kwa ajili yenu, anga limezuia umande wake na nchi imezuia mavuno yake.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu anga halileti umande na ardhi haitoi mazao. Ni kwa sababu yenu.

vi.L: Vì thế, bởi cớ các ngươi, các tầng trời đã giữ lại sương móc, và đất đã giữ lại hoa lợi của nó.
vi.B: Vì vậy, bởi các ngươi mà trời đã cầm giữ sương móc và đất đã cầm giữ hoa màu.
vi.R: Vì thế trời không cho sương xuống và đất không sinh hoa màu. Ấy là vì các ngươi.

ko.L: 그러므로 너희 때문에 하늘은 이슬을 멈추었고, 땅은 그 소산을 멈추었다.
ko.B: 그래서 너희 때문에 하늘이 이슬을 내리지 않고, 땅이 곡식을 내지 않는 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 하늘에서 이슬이 내리지 않고, 땅에서 곡식이 자라지 않는다. 이것은 너희 때문이다.

decisions.choice: dew: the moisture that keeps crops alive in the dry season
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel no rain falls from late spring to autumn. In those months the heavy night dew waters the crops and vines. Without it the summer harvest of grapes and olives fails (Genesis 27:28; 1 Kings 17:1). |

decisions.choice: the heavens withheld, the earth withheld: the curse of the covenant
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:23-24 and Leviticus 26:19-20 warn that the sky will be like bronze and the ground like iron for a people who turn from the LORD. |

decisions.choice: because of you: the cause is the people's neglect
decisions.reason: The words "on you" are hard to fit into the sentence, and the Greek translation is generally said to lack them. Taken as "because of you" or "on your account", they repeat the point of verse 9.

decisions.choice: held back (L), kept back (B), does not send (R)
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for the heavens and for the earth, and Literal and Balanced use one English verb for both. |

source.text: וָאֶקְרָ֨א חֹ֜רֶב עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ וְעַל־הֶהָרִ֗ים וְעַל־הַדָּגָן֙ וְעַל־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְעַל־הַיִּצְהָ֔ר וְעַ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹצִ֖יא הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְעַל־הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כָּל־יְגִ֥יעַ כַּפָּֽיִם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I have called for a drought on the land and on the mountains and on the grain and on the new wine and on the fresh oil and on what the ground brings forth and on humankind and on livestock and on all [the] labor of [the] hands.

en.L: And I have called for a drought on the land and on the mountains and on the grain and on the new wine and on the fresh oil, and on what the soil brings forth, and on humankind and on livestock, and on all the labor of [their] hands.
en.B: I have called down a drought on the land and the hills, on the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, on everything the soil produces, on people and animals, and on all the work of your hands.
en.R: I have sent a drought on the land and the hills. It has fallen on the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, and on everything else that grows. It has hurt people and animals and ruined all your hard work.

es.L: Y llamé a la sequía sobre la tierra y sobre los montes, y sobre el grano y sobre el vino nuevo y sobre el aceite fresco, y sobre lo que produce el suelo, y sobre los seres humanos y sobre el ganado, y sobre todo el trabajo de [sus] manos.
es.B: He hecho venir una sequía sobre la tierra y los montes, sobre el grano, el vino nuevo y el aceite de oliva, sobre todo lo que produce el suelo, sobre las personas y los animales, y sobre todo el trabajo de {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}.
es.R: He enviado una sequía sobre la tierra y los montes. Ha caído sobre el grano, el vino nuevo y el aceite de oliva, y sobre todo lo demás que crece. Ha dañado a la gente y a los animales, y ha arruinado todo {{plural_you:su duro trabajo|vuestro duro trabajo}}.

fr.L: Et j’ai appelé la sécheresse sur le pays et sur les montagnes, et sur le blé et sur le vin nouveau et sur l’huile fraîche, et sur ce que produit le sol, et sur les humains et sur le bétail, et sur tout le travail de [leurs] mains.
fr.B: J’ai fait venir la sécheresse sur le pays et sur les collines, sur le blé, le vin nouveau et l’huile d’olive, sur tout ce que produit le sol, sur les humains et les bêtes, et sur tout le travail de vos mains.
fr.R: J’ai envoyé la sécheresse sur le pays et sur les collines. Elle a frappé le blé, le vin nouveau et l’huile d’olive, et tout ce qui pousse. Elle a fait souffrir les gens et les animaux, et elle a ruiné tout votre dur travail.

sw.L: Nami nimeita ukame juu ya nchi na juu ya milima, na juu ya nafaka na juu ya divai mpya na juu ya mafuta mapya, na juu ya kile ambacho ardhi hutoa, na juu ya wanadamu na juu ya mifugo, na juu ya kazi yote ya mikono [yao].
sw.B: Nimeleta ukame juu ya nchi na milima, juu ya nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni, juu ya kila kitu ambacho ardhi huzaa, juu ya watu na wanyama, na juu ya kazi yote ya mikono yenu.
sw.R: Nimeleta ukame juu ya nchi na milima. Umeipata nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni, na kila kitu kingine kinachoota. Umewadhuru watu na wanyama, na umeharibu kazi yenu yote ngumu.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi hạn hán đến trên đất và trên các núi, trên lúa và trên rượu mới và trên dầu mới, và trên những gì đất sinh ra, và trên loài người và trên súc vật, và trên mọi công lao của tay [họ].
vi.B: Ta đã giáng hạn hán trên đất và đồi núi, trên lúa thóc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu, trên mọi thứ đất sinh ra, trên người và thú vật, và trên mọi công việc tay các ngươi làm.
vi.R: Ta đã giáng hạn hán trên đất và đồi núi. Hạn hán làm hại lúa thóc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu, cùng mọi thứ khác mọc lên từ đất. Nó làm khổ người và thú vật, và phá hỏng mọi công khó của các ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 땅과 산들과 곡식과 새 포도주와 새 기름과 땅이 내는 것과 사람과 가축과 [그들의] 손으로 하는 모든 수고 위에 가뭄을 불러들였다.
ko.B: 내가 땅과 산들 위에, 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름 위에, 땅에서 나는 모든 것 위에, 사람과 짐승 위에, 그리고 너희 손으로 하는 모든 일 위에 가뭄을 불러들였다.
ko.R: 내가 땅과 산들에 가뭄을 보냈다. 가뭄이 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름, 그리고 자라는 모든 것에 내렸다. 사람과 짐승이 고통을 당했고, 너희가 애써 한 일이 모두 헛수고가 되었다.

decisions.choice: drought: dryness, a play on "desolate"
decisions.reason: The word for "drought" (chorev) sounds like the word for the "desolate" house (charev, verses 4 and 9). Because they let the LORD's house lie waste, their land lies dry. |

decisions.choice: the grain, the new wine and the oil: the three main crops of the land
decisions.reason: Grain, new wine and olive oil were the chief harvests of Israel and stand for all its produce (Deuteronomy 7:13; Hosea 2:10; Joel 1:10). |

decisions.choice: the labor of the hands: all their work
decisions.reason: The "labor of the hands" is everything people work at to make a living (Deuteronomy 28:12; Psalm 128:2). |

decisions.choice: the work of your hands (B), your hard work (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the labor of hands". Literal supplies "[their]"; Balanced and Readable say "your", because the LORD is speaking to the people. |

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל׀בֶּֽן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֡ל וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְכֹ֣ל׀שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֗ם בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ חַגַּ֣י הַנָּבִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלָח֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מִפְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to [the] voice of Yahweh their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared before Yahweh.

en.L: And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God had sent him; and the people feared before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the rest of the people, did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God said and heeded the words of the prophet Haggai, since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God had sent him. And the people feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the people who were left obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They listened to what the prophet Haggai said, because he had been sent by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. And the people were filled with awe in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y todo el remanente del pueblo escucharon la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios y las palabras de Hageo el profeta, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios lo había enviado; y el pueblo temió delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Entonces Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, con todo el remanente del pueblo, hicieron lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios dijo y atendieron a las palabras del profeta Hageo, ya que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios lo había enviado. Y el pueblo temió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y todos los que quedaban del pueblo obedecieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. Escucharon lo que dijo el profeta Hageo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios lo había enviado. Y el pueblo se llenó de reverencia ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, et Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et tout le reste du peuple écoutèrent la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu et les paroles du prophète Aggée, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu l’avait envoyé ; et le peuple eut peur devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Alors Zorobabel fils de Salathiel et Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, avec tout le reste du peuple, firent ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu avait dit et écoutèrent les paroles du prophète Aggée, puisque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu l’avait envoyé. Et le peuple craignit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et tous ceux qui restaient du peuple ont obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Ils ont écouté ce que disait le prophète Aggée, parce que c’était {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu qui l’avait envoyé. Et le peuple a été rempli d’une crainte respectueuse devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ndipo Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na mabaki yote ya watu wakaisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao na maneno ya Hagai nabii, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao alikuwa amemtuma; nao watu wakaogopa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ndipo Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, pamoja na mabaki yote ya watu, walifanya kile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao alichosema, wakayasikiliza maneno ya nabii Hagai, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao alikuwa amemtuma. Nao watu wakamcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ndipo Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na watu wote waliobaki walimtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Walisikiliza yale nabii Hagai aliyosema, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao ndiye aliyemtuma. Nao watu wakajawa na hofu ya heshima mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, và Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, cùng tất cả những người sót lại của dân đã nghe theo tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và lời của nhà tiên tri A-ghê, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ đã sai ông; và dân sự kính sợ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên và Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, cùng tất cả những người sót lại trong dân, đã làm theo điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ phán và nghe theo lời nhà tiên tri A-ghê, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ đã sai ông đến. Và dân sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tất cả những người dân còn sống sót đã vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ nghe theo lời nhà tiên tri A-ghê, vì ông được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sai đến. Và dân chúng đầy lòng kính sợ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 백성 가운데 남은 모든 자가 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리와 예언자 학개의 말을 들었다. 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 보내셨기 때문이다. 그리고 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 두려워했다.
ko.B: 그러자 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 남은 모든 백성이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀을 따르고, 예언자 학개의 말을 귀담아들었다. 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 보내셨기 때문이다. 그리고 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워했다.
ko.R: 그러자 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 살아남은 모든 백성이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종했다. 그들은 예언자 학개가 하는 말을 들었다. 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 보내셨기 때문이다. 그리고 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 두려운 마음으로 가득 찼다.

decisions.choice: all the remnant of the people: the whole community that had returned
decisions.reason: "Remnant" here means the people who had come back from exile and were living in Judah, the survivors of the nation (Ezra 9:8, 13; Zechariah 8:6). |

decisions.choice: the people feared before the LORD: they were filled with reverent awe
decisions.reason: Fear of the LORD is the awe that leads to obedience (Deuteronomy 10:12). Here the people take the word seriously; verse 13 answers their fear with comfort. |

decisions.choice: as the LORD their God had sent him: because Haggai was truly sent
decisions.reason: They obeyed the prophet's words because they recognized that he spoke for the LORD. |

decisions.choice: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest
decisions.reason: The names keep the wording of verse 1; here the Hebrew does not give Zerubbabel's title. Literal keeps "listened to the voice", the Hebrew idiom; Balanced says "did what the LORD their God said" and Readable "obeyed". |

decisions.choice: "todo el remanente del pueblo" (L, B); "todos los que quedaban del pueblo" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant follows the prophets' term sheet: "remanente" at Literal and Balanced, a plain description at Readable, as the English does. Here it is the community back from exile (m1).

decisions.choice: "tout le reste du peuple" (L, B); "tous ceux qui restaient du peuple" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant as the term sheet sets it: "le reste" at Literal and Balanced, "ceux qui restent" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "mabaki yote ya watu" (L, B); "watu wote waliobaki" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant as the Isaiah note sets it, here the community back from exile (m1).

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (L, B); "những người dân còn sống sót" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant as the Isaiah note and the term sheet set it; the subject of the narrative is "họ", and Haggai is "ông".

decisions.choice: "백성 가운데 남은 모든 자" (L); "남은 모든 백성" (B); "살아남은 모든 백성" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant follows the Isaiah note (남은 자 / 남은 사람들 / 살아남은 사람들), joined to 백성 because the Hebrew says "the remnant of the people".

source.text: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר חַגַּ֞י מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה בְּמַלְאֲכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה לָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֥י אִתְּכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Haggai, [the] messenger of Yahweh, spoke with [the] message of Yahweh to the people, saying: I [am] with you, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: And Haggai, the messenger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, spoke with the message of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the people, saying, "I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Then Haggai, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s messenger, gave the people {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s message: "I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Then Haggai, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s messenger, gave the people this message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "I am with you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Y Hageo, el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, habló con el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al pueblo, diciendo: «Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Entonces Hageo, el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, le dio al pueblo el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Entonces Hageo, el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, le dio al pueblo este mensaje de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et Aggée, le messager {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, parla avec le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au peuple, disant : « Je suis avec vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Alors Aggée, le messager {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, transmit au peuple le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Je suis avec vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Alors Aggée, le messager {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, a transmis au peuple ce message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Je suis avec vous, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Ndipo Hagai, mjumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema na watu kwa ujumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kusema, "Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Ndipo Hagai, mjumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawapa watu ujumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Ndipo Hagai, mjumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawapa watu ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.B: Bấy giờ A-ghê, sứ giả của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, truyền sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho dân chúng: "Ta ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.R: Bấy giờ A-ghê, sứ giả của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, truyền cho dân sứ điệp này từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ta ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán."

ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사자 학개가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 말씀을 백성에게 전했다. "내가 너희와 함께 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사자 학개가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 이 말씀을 백성에게 전했다. "내가 너희와 함께 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

decisions.choice: the messenger of the LORD: the prophet as the one who carries the LORD's word
decisions.reason: The word means "messenger" and is also used of angels. Here it is the prophet Haggai, sent with the LORD's message, as priests (Malachi 2:7) and prophets (Isaiah 44:26; 2 Chronicles 36:15-16) are called the LORD's messengers. Malachi's name means "my messenger". |

decisions.choice: I am with you: the LORD's promise of his presence
decisions.reason: God made the same promise to Jacob (Genesis 28:15), to Moses (Exodus 3:12) and to his people in exile (Isaiah 43:2, 5). With it, the people can begin the work. It is repeated in 2:4. |

decisions.choice: the messenger of the LORD (L), the LORD's messenger (B, R), lowercase
decisions.reason: "Messenger" is lowercase at every level, because the messenger is the prophet. The message is quoted in double quotes, as prose quotes speech. |

decisions.choice: "el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}", lowercase
decisions.reason: The messenger is the prophet himself (m1), so the word is lowercase and takes no deity span; it is the same word, "mensajero", as Malachi's name and Malachi 3:1.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사자 학개"; "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 말씀" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "사자" is the term sheet's word for "my messenger" in Malachi 3:1, which shares the Hebrew word; it is used of the prophet here and takes no -시-. Literal turns "with the message of the LORD" into "the word the LORD entrusted to him", since Korean has no idiom for speaking "with a message".

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work on [the] house of Yahweh of hosts, their God,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people; they came, and they worked in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, their God,
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and that of everyone else among the people. They came and set to work on the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, their God,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the people who were left eager to work. They came and began working on the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, their God.

es.B: Así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} despertó el espíritu de Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, el espíritu de Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y el de todo el remanente del pueblo. Vinieron y se pusieron a trabajar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, su Dios,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y todos los que quedaban del pueblo tuvieran ganas de trabajar. Vinieron y comenzaron a trabajar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, su Dios.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réveilla l’esprit de Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, et l’esprit de Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et l’esprit de tout le reste du peuple ; et ils vinrent, et ils travaillèrent à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu,
fr.B: Ainsi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réveilla l’esprit de Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, l’esprit de Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et celui de tout le reste du peuple. Ils vinrent et se mirent à l’œuvre à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, à Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et à tous ceux qui restaient du peuple le désir de travailler. Ils sont venus et ont commencé à travailler au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giục giã tâm thần của Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, và tâm thần của Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tâm thần của tất cả những người sót lại của dân; và họ đến và làm việc trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ,
vi.B: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giục giã tâm thần của Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, tâm thần của Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tâm thần của tất cả những người sót lại trong dân. Họ đến và bắt tay vào công việc trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khiến cho Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tất cả những người dân còn sống sót hăng hái làm việc. Họ đến và bắt đầu làm việc tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨의 영과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아의 영과 백성 가운데 남은 모든 자의 영을 일깨우셨다. 그러자 그들이 와서 그들의 하나님, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 일을 하였다.
ko.B: 그리하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨의 마음과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아의 마음과 남은 모든 백성의 마음을 일깨우셨다. 그들은 와서 그들의 하나님, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 짓는 일에 착수하였다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 총독 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 살아남은 모든 백성에게 일하고 싶은 열심을 주셨다. 그들은 와서 그들의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 일을 시작했다.

decisions.choice: stirred up the spirit: moved them to act
decisions.reason: To stir up someone's spirit is to rouse their will and courage to do something. The LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus to send the exiles home and the spirit of those who went (Ezra 1:1, 5). |

decisions.choice: they came and did work on the house: the rebuilding begins again
decisions.reason: Ezra 5:1-2 tells how Zerubbabel and Jeshua began to build the house of God again, with the prophets Haggai and Zechariah helping them. The temple was finished in the sixth year of Darius, in 515 BC (Ezra 6:15). |

decisions.choice: the names as in verse 1; made ... eager to work (R)
decisions.reason: The names keep the wording of verse 1. Readable says what stirring up the spirit means (m1). Literal and Balanced end with a comma because the date in verse 15 belongs to this sentence. |

decisions.choice: Literal and Balanced close the verse with a period, and the date of verse 15 is its own sentence
decisions.reason: A Korean sentence ends in its verb, so the date that the Hebrew adds after the verb (verse 15) cannot trail after it as in English; it becomes a short sentence of its own. Spirit (ruach) of a person is "영" at Literal and "마음" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month: late September 520 BC
decisions.reason: The date is about 21 September 520 BC, twenty-three days after Haggai's first message (verse 1). The time may have been needed to gather materials, or the harvest of grapes, figs and olives in that month may have delayed the start. |

decisions.choice: the date closes 1:14
alternatives: the second half of the verse begins 2:1
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text marks a new paragraph here, and some readers join the first half of the verse to 1:14 and the second half ("in the second year of Darius the king") to 2:1, which otherwise has no year. Read as one date, the verse gives the day on which the work on the temple began.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew form of the date at every level
decisions.reason: The date keeps the form set for Haggai, as in verse 1. Literal says "in the sixth" without "month", as the Hebrew does. Literal and Balanced continue the sentence of verse 14; Readable makes the date a sentence of its own. |
